title: The Cage-Bird and the Bat
summary: A bird in a cage sang only at night. A bat asked why she was silent during the day....
full_text:
A bird in a cage sang only at night. A bat asked why she was silent during the day.

The bird replied: "I sang by day and was caught; now I know better!"

The bat said: "Your caution comes too late, now that you are already in chains!"
moral: Precautions taken after the trap has closed are useless.
